acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] Given packages/rcf-lite/package.json pinning an rcf-schemas version that is not published on the npm registry, when pnpm install --frozen-lockfile runs in this repository, then it exits non-zero; the slice's pull request therefore moves the pin only to a published rcf-schemas release, and pnpm-lock.yaml at the slice head resolves "@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas" to that same version.

[must-not] No Code Node recorded for a criterion of this story names a path outside this repository: every rcf/code-nodes/ record whose implementsAcIds names a criterion of REQ-195 has a path that resolves under packages/rcf-lite/ (the writer and schema-loading seams), and none names node_modules/ or a path in the rcf-schemas repository.
